# Nested Hex

> Nested Hex is an adapter that lets 4mm precision screwdriver bits (the small hex-shank bits found in electronics, phone, laptop, eyeglass, and hobby repair kits) fit a standard magnetic screwdriver. Sold as a 3 pack in radiant orange, ultra-tough polymer, half the size of other adapters, full magnetic retention, patent pending ({{ site.patent }}). Designed and made in America by a family-owned business; a ZingLab LLC product. Free shipping within the US. Buy direct at {{ site.url }}/ (secure Stripe checkout). Amazon and Walmart listings coming soon.
